home.headline: Spotted a pothole?
home.subtext: Report it in 30 seconds. No sign-up needed.
home.mapLink: See all reported potholes on the map

permission.explain: RoadSense needs your camera to photograph the pothole and your location to put it on the map.

capture.title: Report a pothole
capture.instruction: Point your camera at the pothole. Stand 1–2 m away.

review.title: Check your report
review.pinHint: Is the pin on the pothole? Drag it if not.
review.privacy: We blur faces and number plates. We don't collect your name or number.

result.titleNew: Thanks! Your report is on the map.
result.titleMerged: Thanks! Added to an existing report.
result.mergedDetail_one: {{count}} person has reported this spot. More reports help it get fixed sooner.
result.mergedDetail_other: {{count}} people have reported this spot. More reports help it get fixed sooner.
result.titleNeedsReview: Thanks. An engineer will check your photo.
result.titleProcessing: We've saved your report and will finish it shortly.
result.shareText: I reported a pothole on RoadSense. Track it here:

track.title: Track a report
track.noDamage: We couldn't find road damage in this photo, and it was not sent to an engineer.

citizen.reported: Reported on {{date}}. Waiting for an engineer to check.
citizen.needs_review: Our AI wasn't sure. An engineer will check your photo.
citizen.fixed: Marked fixed on {{date}}. Thanks for reporting.
citizen.rejected: An engineer found no road damage at this spot.

explain.minor: Small damage. Worth fixing, not urgent.
explain.moderate: Noticeable damage. Can hurt tyres and slow traffic.
explain.dangerous: Deep or large damage in the wheel path. Ride carefully here.

errors.cameraBlocked: Camera access is off. Turn it on in your browser settings, or choose a photo from your gallery.
errors.locationBlocked: We can't see your location. Drag the pin to where the pothole is.
errors.weakGps: Your location is approximate. Please check the pin.
errors.noDamage: We couldn't find road damage in this photo. Try a closer photo in good light.
errors.tooDark: This photo is too dark or blurry to check.

errors.slowServer: Still checking… We've saved your report and will finish it shortly.

errors.outsidePilot: RoadSense works only in {{area}} right now.
errors.rateLimited: Too many reports from this network. Please try again in an hour.
errors.wrongCode: No report found with this code. Check it and try again.
errors.invalidImage: This file is not a photo we can read. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: We couldn't load this page. Check your connection and try again.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 10 minutes.
errors.sessionExpired: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.demoReadOnly: The demo account is read only. Sign in as an engineer to make changes.
errors.invalidTransition: This status change isn't allowed from the current status.

empty.dashboard: No reports yet. Share the report link to get started.

drive.title: Drive mode
drive.safety: Mount your phone before you ride. Don't touch it while moving.
drive.setup: Point the camera at the road, about 5–10 m ahead.
